title: Complement Lookup
summary: For a relation such as a + b = target, let the current item determine the counterpart that would complete the relation and look only for that counterpart in earlier state.
recognition_signals: the current item implies one needed counterpart
the relation can be rearranged to solve for the missing value
a previous matching item must be found without scanning all earlier items
core_rules: Derive the needed counterpart from the current value and target before performing the lookup.
Keep only eligible earlier items in the lookup state so the current item cannot accidentally reuse itself when distinct indexes are required.
structural_steps: rearrange the relation to compute the needed counterpart
look for that counterpart in earlier keyed state
return or record a match if found
store the current item for later positions

common_confusions.distinction: Complement lookup is a specific keyed-lookup pattern where the current item computes exactly which earlier key is needed.
